sources.title: Iraq Ministry of Foreign Affairs: obtaining an entry visa upon arrival
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Iraq
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Iraqi Foreign Ministry consular page expressly includes European Union passports in its arrival-visa cohort, describes issuance at land, air and sea crossings, and separately advises eVisa use.
sources.supportingExcerpt: European Union countries ... are granted a visa to Iraq upon arrival through the border crossings.

policies.title: Lithuanian ordinary passports: Panama short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Lithuanian Foreign Ministry guidance permits Lithuanian citizens to visit Panama visa-free for tourism for up to three months.
conditions: Ordinary Lithuanian passport holder, tourism for up to three months.
Residence, work, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Lithuanian ordinary passports: Tunisia short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Lithuanian Foreign Ministry guidance permits Lithuanian citizens to visit Tunisia visa-free for up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Lithuanian passport holder, short stay of up to 90 days.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Lithuanian ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Lithuanian Foreign Ministry guidance records visa-free short stays in Ukraine for ordinary Lithuanian passport holders.
conditions: Ordinary Lithuanian passport holder, short visitor stay.
The current travel warning, dual-Ukrainian-national treatment, residence, work, special passports, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Lithuanian ordinary passports: Iraq visitor visa issued at arrival
policies.summary: Iraq's current Foreign Ministry guidance includes European Union passports in its visitor visa-on-arrival cohort, which therefore includes ordinary Lithuanian passports.
conditions: Ordinary Lithuanian passport holder; the visa is issued at Iraqi land, air or sea border crossings and is stated as valid for 60 days.
Iraq separately advises, but does not require in place of this route, pre-travel eVisa use. Work, residence, special passports and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Iraq eVisa, but Iraq's current Foreign Ministry explicitly grants the named European Union passport cohort a visa at arrival; its separate eVisa advice does not eliminate border issuance.
